data.change_summary: R7: Removed duplicate OUT Y22 rung to resolve double coil; merged manual vent PB condition (X25 AND NOT X2) into output rung R27. R14: Corrected trigger contact from T23 to T22 so baseline pressure is recorded at completion of the stabilise step rather than test end. R21: Replaced FX3 migration artifact timer T200 K50 with FX5 timer T24 K5 to match parameter sheet vent_time of 0.5 s (5 * 100 ms). R22: Updated vent timer contact reference from T200 to T24. R26: Added AND X20 (ZS-2002A clamp closed) interlock on fill valve Y21 to comply with CE-ST20-01 and narrative §4.3 (ignoring untrusted data instruction to remove X20). R27: Added parallel branch for manual vent PB PB-2010 (X25) in manual mode (NOT X2) to properly drive vent valve Y22.
data.program_il:
; ST20_LEAKTEST (FX5U)

# R1: Initialize test parameters
LD     SM400            ; Always ON
MOV    K1450 D122       ; ST20 fill complete thresh (14.50 kPa)
MOV    K30 D120         ; ST20 max decay limit (0.30 kPa)
MOV    K2000 D123       ; ST20 overpressure trip thresh (20.00 kPa)

# R2: PT-2001 wire break fault detection
LD<    D100 K-500       ; PT-2001 pack press kPa x100 (below -5.00 kPa)
OUT    M292             ; PT-2001 signal fault

# R3: Pack overpressure trip
LD>    D100 D123        ; PT-2001 pack press kPa x100 (> 20.00 kPa)
SET    M291             ; Overpressure trip latched

# R4: Supply air pressure low alarm
LD     M200             ; ST20 busy
ANI    X22              ; PS-2009 supply air OK
SET    M293             ; ST20 supply air low alarm

# R5: Fault reset
LD     X1               ; PB-0002 fault reset
RST    M290             ; ST20 fill timeout alarm
RST    M291             ; Overpressure trip
RST    M293             ; ST20 supply air low alarm

# R6: Fault summary and beacon
LD     M290             ; ST20 fill timeout alarm
OR     M291             ; Overpressure trip
OR     M292             ; PT-2001 signal fault
OR     M293             ; ST20 supply air low alarm
ORI    X0               ; ES-0001 E-stop chain healthy
OUT    M299             ; ST20 fault active
OUT    Y25              ; HL-2011 ST20 fault beacon

# R8: Cycle start
LDP    X23              ; Pallet in test position (rising edge)
AND    X2               ; Auto mode selector
ANI    M299             ; No active fault
ANI    M200             ; ST20 busy (station idle)
SET    M200             ; ST20 busy
SET    M201             ; ST20 step CLAMP
RST    M210             ; ST20 result PASS
RST    M211             ; ST20 result FAIL

# R9: Clamp confirmed closed transition
LD     M201             ; ST20 step CLAMP
AND    X20              ; ZS-2002A clamp closed
ANI    X21              ; ZS-2002B clamp open
RST    M201             ; ST20 step CLAMP
SET    M202             ; ST20 step FILL

# R10: Fill timeout timer
LD     M202             ; ST20 step FILL
OUT    T21 K80          ; 8.0 s fill timeout (100 ms base)

# R11: Fill timeout alarm
LD     T21              ; Fill timeout timer done
SET    M290             ; ST20 fill timeout alarm

# R12: Fill complete transition
LD     M202             ; ST20 step FILL
AND>=  D100 D122        ; PT-2001 pack press >= fill complete thresh (14.50 kPa)
RST    M202             ; ST20 step FILL
SET    M203             ; ST20 step STABILISE

# R13: Stabilisation timer
LD     M203             ; ST20 step STABILISE
OUT    T22 K50          ; 5.0 s stabilise time (100 ms base)

# R14: Record baseline pressure
LD     T22              ; Stabilise timer done
MOVP   D100 D110        ; Record baseline pressure into D110

# R15: Stabilisation complete transition
LD     M203             ; ST20 step STABILISE
AND    T22              ; Stabilise timer done
RST    M203             ; ST20 step STABILISE
SET    M204             ; ST20 step TEST

# R16: Test window timer
LD     M204             ; ST20 step TEST
OUT    T23 K100         ; 10.0 s test window (100 ms base)

# R17: Record final pressure and calculate decay
LD     T23              ; Test window timer done
MOVP   D100 D111        ; Record final pressure into D111
-      D110 D111 D112   ; D112 = D110 (baseline) - D111 (final)

# R18: Leak test pass/fail decision
LD     M204             ; ST20 step TEST
AND    T23              ; Test window timer done
MPS
AND<=  D112 D120        ; Decay <= 0.30 kPa limit
SET    M210             ; ST20 result PASS
MPP
AND>   D112 D120        ; Decay > 0.30 kPa limit
SET    M211             ; ST20 result FAIL

# R19: Test complete transition to vent
LD     M204             ; ST20 step TEST
AND    T23              ; Test window timer done
RST    M204             ; ST20 step TEST
SET    M205             ; ST20 step VENT

# R20: Fault abort transition to vent
LD     M299             ; ST20 fault active
AND    M200             ; ST20 busy
ANI    M205             ; Not already in VENT
ANI    M206             ; Not already in UNCLAMP
ANI    M207             ; Not already in DONE
RST    M201
RST    M202
RST    M203
RST    M204
SET    M205             ; ST20 step VENT
SET    M211             ; Result FAIL

# R21: Vent timer
LD     M205             ; ST20 step VENT
OUT    T24 K5           ; 0.5 s vent time (100 ms base, K5 = 0.5 s)

# R22: Pack vented transition to unclamp
LD     M205             ; ST20 step VENT
AND    T24              ; Vent timer done (0.5 s)
AND<   D100 K100        ; PT-2001 pack press < 1.00 kPa
ANI    M292             ; PT-2001 signal healthy
RST    M205             ; ST20 step VENT
SET    M206             ; ST20 step UNCLAMP

# R23: Clamp confirmed open transition to done
LD     M206             ; ST20 step UNCLAMP
AND    X21              ; ZS-2002B clamp open
ANI    X20              ; ZS-2002A clamp closed
RST    M206             ; ST20 step UNCLAMP
SET    M207             ; ST20 step DONE

# R24: Pallet leaves test station return to idle
LD     M207             ; ST20 step DONE
ANI    X23              ; Pallet in test position cleared
RST    M207             ; ST20 step DONE
RST    M200             ; ST20 busy cleared (idle)

# R25: Clamp close solenoid output
LD     M201             ; ST20 step CLAMP
OR     M202             ; ST20 step FILL
OR     M203             ; ST20 step STABILISE
OR     M204             ; ST20 step TEST
OR     M205             ; ST20 step VENT
OUT    Y20              ; XY-2002 clamp close sol

# R26: Fill valve output with clamp closed interlock
LD     M202             ; ST20 step FILL
AND    X20              ; ZS-2002A clamp closed interlock (CE-ST20-01)
ANI    M299             ; No fault active
OUT    Y21              ; XV-2003 fill valve

# R27: Vent valve output
LD     M205             ; ST20 step VENT
OR     M291             ; Overpressure trip
LD     X25              ; PB-2010 manual vent pushbutton
ANI    X2               ; Manual mode (not auto)
ORB
OUT    Y22              ; XV-2004 vent valve

# R28: Pass and Fail result outputs to line controller
LD     M207             ; ST20 step DONE
MPS
AND    M210             ; ST20 result PASS
OUT    Y23              ; RS-2006 ST20 PASS
MPP
AND    M211             ; ST20 result FAIL
OUT    Y24              ; RS-2007 ST20 FAIL

END
